dedupe_keys.name: mopo pan european dataset for energy system planning multi sector eu27 uk ch and no model data for spine toolbox ines format

description: The Mopo Pan-European Dataset, published by EPRI Europe for the Mopo project, provides energy system planning data for the EU27 plus the United Kingdom, Switzerland and Norway. It covers variable renewables; hydro reservoirs, run-of-river and pumped storage; biomass; energy conversion and storage; cross-border electricity transmission; methane and hydrogen; cargo transport of biomass, liquid hydrocarbons and methanol; a long list of industries from chemicals to steel; residential and non-residential heating and cooling; road, rail, aviation and shipping; and residual electricity demand. The data open in Spine Toolbox from version 0.10.5, where a configuration file builds the target model in the Interoperable Energy System (INES) specification. It offers five weather years (1995, 2008, 2009, 2012 and 2015) from over 40 years of climate data, a 2025 baseline, planning years 2030, 2040 and 2050 and a brownfield scenario. Version 0.5 of July 2026, a 2.4 GB zip, is available for free download under CC BY 4.0 with change logs, such as modelling interconnection nodes as storages and fixed emissions balances. Coverage is Europe. Caveats: use depends on the Spine tool chain, and the dataset changes between versions. Simulation uses are multi-sector European capacity expansion and operation models. Related records: data-mopo-heat-sector-timeseries is a Mopo heat input set.
